name: explain-c-module
description: Explain embedded C/C++ modules, RTOS tasks, drivers, interrupts, DMA, low-power code and call chains; generate Chinese Markdown and interactive HTML learning documentation.

interface.shortDescription: 分析 Embedded C、RTOS 和驱动并生成学习文档
interface.longDescription: Explain C/C++ embedded modules, RTOS tasks, drivers, interrupts, DMA, low-power paths, call graphs, resource lifecycles and hardware concepts; generate Chinese Markdown and interactive HTML documentation.
defaultPrompt: 用 explain-c-module 讲解这个 C 模块
分析这个嵌入式目录的调用链和 RTOS 知识
分析这个 C 驱动、中断、DMA 或低功耗实现
生成该驱动模块的中文 Markdown 和 HTML 文档
